description: This file is a C header file defining the API for configuring Energy-Efficient Ethernet (EEE) settings for a Realtek switch device, specifically the RTL8367C chip. It includes function prototypes for enabling and retrieving EEE settings at different speeds (100M and Giga), and defines relevant constants.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicEee100M
methods.description: Sets the EEE enable state for 100M speed on a specified port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicEee100M
methods.description: Retrieves the EEE enable state for 100M speed on a specified port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicEeeGiga
methods.description: Sets the EEE enable state for Giga speed on a specified port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicEeeGiga
methods.description: Retrieves the EEE enable state for Giga speed on a specified port.
